Barcode.title: Barcode
Barcode.description: A scannable code (EAN, GTIN, UPC, SSCC, or internal) bound to a Product at a specific unit-of-measure. A single Product carries 1.N barcodes: one per UoM or channel (e.g. EAN-13 per unit, GTIN-14 per carton, SSCC per pallet). Declared as a separate register (not an inline array on Product) so barcodes are individually queryable, auditable, and have an independent lifecycle (deactivate without delete). Consumed by the shillinq barcode lookup endpoint and the pipelinq pos-barcode-scan module. Spec: inventory-barcode-sku. Depends on inventory-product-catalog (Product schema). The 'InventoryItem' wording in the spec refers to the shillinq Product schema.

barcode.description: The barcode value as printed/scanned (e.g. 5410317126589 for an EAN-13).
barcode.title: Barcode

barcodeType.description: The barcode standard family. EAN/GTIN/UPC/SSCC are GS1 standards; INTERNAL is a non-standard custom code (e.g. a legacy ERP code).
barcodeType.title: Barcode Type

format.description: The specific barcode format for disambiguation within a type (e.g. EAN-13, EAN-8, GTIN-14, UPC-A, SSCC-18, INTERNAL).
format.title: Format

productId.description: FK to pipelinq Product (productId). Required. Resolved via ADR-019 integration registry.
productId.title: Product ID

productSku.description: TRANSITIONAL ALIAS: deprecated. Use productId. Retained for 3-way-match fallback only. Will be removed after pipelinq-product-vendor-master is confirmed live.
productSku.title: Product SKU

uomCode.description: UN/CEFACT unit-of-measure code this barcode represents: EA (each), CA (carton/case), PL (pallet), etc.
uomCode.title: Uom Code

quantity.description: How many base units this barcode represents (1 for a single unit, 4 for a carton of four, 100 for a pallet). Must be >= 1.
quantity.title: Quantity

isDefault.description: True when this is the primary/default barcode scanned at retail POS for the product.
isDefault.title: Is Default

isActive.description: True when the barcode is in use. Inactive barcodes (deprecated supplier/legacy codes) are retained for audit but excluded from the lookup endpoint.
isActive.title: Is Active
